description: A family-run apple orchard in 235 N. Ford Road, IN, Apple Hill Orchard grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The orchard is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
